packageRules.description: Match pnpm's 7-day minimumReleaseAge. config:best-practices sets 3 days for npm.

The published declarations are built with this TypeScript, and the apps that consume them (Bristol) are on TypeScript 5. Move to 7 together with them. Vite+ runs its own TypeScript 7 engine for linting either way.
